summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for $2,852,000 of senior fixed-rate 4-year callable notes due September 30, 2030. The notes carry a 6.00% coupon, priced at 100% of par ($1,000 per note), pay annually each September 30 beginning 2027, and are callable on each September 30 from 2027 through 2029 at par plus accrued interest. Jefferies LLC, a subsidiary, is agent, raising conflict-of-interest disclosure under FINRA Rule 5121. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
